notes: These CSV files were copied unchanged from previously collected temporary results.
Historical heavy: 128 rounds, 2048 mixes per round, 3 samples per case.
Historical depth: 256 rounds, unique state each round, 3 samples per case.
Historical switch: 128 rounds, 2048 mixes per round; use 5-sample Clang repeat over noisy initial Clang switching results.
Historical prototype-bank arithmetic is not a direct before/after measurement of the production bank MSO or the adapter.

current_control.mode: C++23 frontend syntax-only, serial processes; reference verification disabled during timing
current_control.memory: Actual GCC cc1plus and in-process Clang peak working set. GCC allocated MiB is cumulative allocation, not peak live memory.
notes: Same existing meta_pipe and meta_object protocol carries a new control state each round.
Calls user_flags_control MSO through meta_object_invoke, cycling four stages and changing input position each round.
Production bank extra segments start nonzero and persist across updates.
Both carriers use the same legacy u128 settlement algorithm; the bank result additionally imports two words.
Does not measure the full enter_window export/projection/transfer path or persistent bank integration into the looper.
Cases run sequentially in fixed order, not randomized; small timing differences may reflect drift and noise.
No complete pre-adapter build baseline was collected, so these are current side-by-side measurements, not whole-library before/after numbers.
No deep smoke tests were executed.
current_control.conclusion: Control bank has no demonstrated substantial compile-time speedup yet; median differences are within approximately 3 percent. Historical heavy native-word arithmetic gains should not be attributed to the current bridge.
